from paraview.simple import *
from paraview import servermanager
r=XMLImageDataReader(FileName=['/workspace/Ionization/Ionization1.vti'])
s=TTKTopologicalSimplificationByPersistence(Input=r); s.InputArray=['POINTS','Scalars_']; s.PersistenceThreshold=0.1; s.ThresholdIsAbsolute=1; s.PairType=0
s.UpdatePipeline()
d=servermanager.Fetch(s)
print('SIMPL',d.GetClassName(),d.GetNumberOfPoints(), [d.GetPointData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(d.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays())])
c=TTKContourTree(Input=s); c.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_']; c.UpdatePipeline()
for p in range(3):
  proxy=OutputPort(c,p)
  dd=servermanager.Fetch(proxy)
  print('PORT',p, dd.GetClassName(),dd.GetNumberOfPoints(),dd.GetNumberOfCells(), [dd.GetPointData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(dd.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays())], [dd.GetCellData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(dd.GetCellData().GetNumberOfArrays())])
PY"
